name: canlang-draft-highlighting
description: Syntax highlighting plus a minimal LSP client for the current canlang draft grammar. Spawns `can lsp` for diagnostics.

scripts.compile: tsc --strict --target es2022 --module commonjs --lib es2022 --typeRoots ./.empty-typeroot --outDir out --rootDir src src/extension.ts src/client.ts
scripts.vscode:prepublish: bun run generate:icons && bun run compile
scripts.test:client: node test/server-startup.cjs && node test/client-currentness.cjs && node test/client-lifecycle.cjs && node test/client-lifecycle-process.cjs

can.serverPath.description: Path to the can binary used to spawn `can lsp`. Defaults to PATH lookup.

can.traceServer.description: Log LSP traffic to the Can output channel.
